# Synthetic extraction fixtures

All files in this directory are parser/OCR/transcription test inputs, not business records. Numbers such as 246813579 are intentional test markers.

Audio was freshly synthesized for this public release from these texts:
- English: This is a synthetic test recording. The amber project review is scheduled for November fifth. Please prepare the project acceptance tasks.
- Chinese: 这是一段合成测试录音。项目验收安排在十一月五日。请整理验收任务。
- silence.wav contains silence.

Office files, PDFs and the scan image contain generated acceptance-test markers and example data. They are not application demo records or source evidence.
